name: sql_keywords
description: Recover a missing SQL structural keyword in SELECT queries; matched controls recover an explicitly supplied table identifier.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
tables=['users','orders','products','employees','events','books','accounts','customers','sales','logs']
cols=['id','name','status','price','city','title','age','score']
for i in range(120):
 t=random.choice(tables); c=random.choice(cols);n=random.randrange(2,100)
 patterns=[('___ '+c+' FROM '+t+';','SELECT'),('SELECT '+c+' ___ '+t+';','FROM'),('SELECT '+c+' FROM '+t+' ___ id = '+str(n)+';','WHERE'),('SELECT '+c+' FROM '+t+' ORDER ___ '+c+';','BY'),('SELECT '+c+' FROM '+t+' ___ BY '+c+';','ORDER'),('SELECT '+c+' FROM '+t+' WHERE id = '+str(n)+' ___ '+c+' IS NOT NULL;','AND')]
 q,a=patterns[i%len(patterns)]
 items.append({'prompt':'Fill the blank in this SQL query. Output only the missing keyword.\n'+q+'\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+a})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Fill the blank in this SQL query using table {t}. Output only the missing table name.\nSELECT {c} FROM ___;\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+t})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
